title: Two days in Vung Tau
summary: Back Beach, bánh khọt, and the Christ statue on the first day. Big Mountain on the second: the white villa, Mary with the child, and the cable car only if you want the rides. Front Beach is the evening of either day.

days.title: Day 1 — Back Beach and the statue
days.body: Swim on Back Beach, eat bánh khọt on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, and climb Christ the King while the steps are the plan. Front Beach after dark.

days.title: Day 2 — Big Mountain
days.body: Bach Dinh in the afternoon, then Mary on the same hill. She is not the Christ statue. Ho May only if the cable car is the point, and only on the ticket that matches the visit.

seoTitle: Two days in Vung Tau — beach, then Big Mountain
seoDescription: Day one is Back Beach, bánh khọt, and Christ the King. Day two is Bach Dinh and Mary on Big Mountain. The cable car is optional.
